FLAGGED, not resolved: (1) the PDF's club history ("River Plate 1971-1978, 1979-1984 - Velez Sarsfield 1984-1987 - River Plate 1987-1988") omits a 1976-77 Olympique de Marseille spell entirely -- confirmed present on Wikipedia (17 apps/3 goals league, though Wikipedia's own infobox separately says 6 goals for this spell, an internal Wikipedia inconsistency) and included in this record instead of the PDF's version; (2) the PDF's Velez Sarsfield years (1984-1987) are wrong -- Wikipedia, RSSSF-adjacent sourcing and a third secondary source all agree he was at Velez Sarsfield in 1982-1983 only, returning to River Plate for 1984; this record uses the corrected 1982-1983 span; (3) PDF states birthplace as "Buenos Aires", Wikipedia specifies "Vicente Lopez, Buenos Aires Province" -- a more specific, different locality; (4) Wikipedia's own infobox (169 goals) and stats-table total (166 goals) disagree with each other; a third source (Liquisearch) corroborates 166, used here as the more likely figure though not independently verified further.

pairingNote: No genuine player-to-player Tactical DNA Pairing exists in this report -- the source PDF's only other comparison content is a non-percentage descriptive lineage tree, "THE LINEAGE -- Law -> Dalglish -> McCoist" (Denis Law, 1960s; Kenny Dalglish, 1970s-80s; Ally McCoist, 1980s-90s; captioned 'the Scottish striker tradition: movement, finishing, mentality, the poacher's instinct'), which carries no scored comparison and is reproduced here for context only, not as a pairing score.
